title: akció and kedvezmény: Sales and Discounts

sections.title: Two words for a better price
sections.content: akció ("sale, promotion") describes a product on sale; kedvezmény ("discount") is the reduction itself. inkább ("rather, preferably") is the natural word for choosing between two products once you've compared them.

items.spanish: Ez a kabát most akcióban van.
items.english: This coat is on sale right now.
There's a big discount in the store.

items.spanish: Inkább a zöld pulóvert választom, mert olyan olcsó, mint a sárga.
items.english: I'd rather choose the green sweater, because it's as cheap as the yellow one.

sections.content: akcióban van and kedvezmény van a boltban both reuse -ban/-ben, and választom reuses the accusative and definite conjugation — this unit keeps building sentences out of grammar you already have, just with fresh shopping vocabulary.
